intro.h2: Detail Work That Changes a Whole Room
paragraphs: LCR Home Solutions is a home remodeling company in Lochbuie, Colorado, and its finish carpentry is what customers talk about first. Jennifer O. had a vision for her dining room, and Luis brought it to life with crown molding and wall molding.

Outside, the crew restores weathered decks and replaces front porches. Tommy W. had his entire front porch replaced in less than a week. The same points come up again and again in the reviews: fair bids, clear and constant communication, and a crew that is pleasant to work with. Luis is the person to call, and his number is the one on the company's Instagram.

items.name: Crown molding and wall molding
items.blurb: Picture-frame wall molding, crown and trim that turn a plain room into a finished one. Jennifer O. wrote that Luis has an exceptional eye for design and meticulous attention to detail, and that he brought her dream dining room to life.

image.alt: Formal dining room with white wall molding panels, tall drapes, a long wood table and an iron chandelier

items.name: Deck restoration and rebuilds
items.blurb: Badly weathered decks brought back into shape, from raised decks with stairs and white railings over a patio to new posts and beams under an existing deck. Sandra H. called Luis reliable and very pleasant to work with on her deck.

image.alt: Raised wood deck with white railings and stairs over a patio, with lattice screening below

items.name: Front porch replacement
items.blurb: Full front porch replacements with new decking and steps. Tommy W. had his entire front porch replaced in less than a week and called the work honest and high quality. On one red brick bungalow, gray decking and new steps gave the house a clean entry.

image.alt: New gray front porch decking and steps between white columns on a red brick house

items.name: Interior and exterior remodeling
items.blurb: Interior and exterior remodeling is printed right on the crew's sweatshirts. If your project is a kitchen, bathroom or other room update rather than trim or a deck, call Luis to describe it and ask whether it suits his crew and schedule.

about.text: LCR Home Solutions LLC is based on Jewel Street in Lochbuie, Colorado. Luis is the contact on the company's Instagram, and reviewers name him as the one who did their work. The jobs range from finish carpentry inside, like crown and wall molding, to decks, porches and other exterior work. Customers describe him as hardworking, reliable and very pleasant to work with, and say he communicates clearly and consistently. Jennifer O. says she will absolutely be hiring him again.

process.h2: From First Call to Finished Room

steps.title: Call Luis
steps.text: Call (720) 350-1984 Monday to Thursday 7 AM to 7 PM, or Friday until 5 PM, and describe the room or structure.

steps.title: Look and bid
steps.text: Luis looks at the space, talks through your ideas and gives you a bid. Reviewers describe the bids as fair.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The crew does the trim, framing or decking. Reviewers say Luis stays in constant communication about the project while the work is underway.

steps.title: Walkthrough
steps.text: Walk the finished work with Luis and check the details before the crew packs up.

items.name: Jennifer O.
items.text: This review is for crown molding and wall molding: I truly cannot emphasize enough how Luis brought my dream dining room to life. I had a vision, and he executed it seamlessly. He has an exceptional eye for design, meticulous attention to detail, and a very high level of skill. He is hardworking, communicates clearly and consistently, and delivers outstanding quality at a fair price. We will absolutely be hiring him again for future projects—we couldn’t be happier with the result.

service_area.text: LCR Home Solutions is based at 579 Jewel St in Lochbuie, Colorado, and its Instagram mentions serving surrounding areas as well. The projects shared on Google include an older brick bungalow, a raised backyard deck and a two-story home with a formal dining room. If you live near Lochbuie and are not sure whether you are in range, call Luis and ask before you plan the project.

items.q: What kind of work does LCR Home Solutions do?
items.a: Finish carpentry such as crown molding and wall molding, deck restoration and rebuilds, front porch replacement, and interior and exterior remodeling. For a project that is not on that list, describe it to Luis on the phone and ask whether it suits his crew. Photos of the space help him understand the job.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the job, so ask Luis about timing when you talk through your project. As one example, a homeowner in the reviews had an entire front porch replaced in less than a week. Another reviewer said the crew was fast and efficient while still doing a quality job.

items.q: How do I get a bid?
items.a: Call Luis at (720) 350-1984 or email lcrhomesolutionsllc@gmail.com with a short description of the project. He can talk through what you want and set up a time to look at the space. Fair bids and clear communication are both topics customers mention in their Google reviews.

Monday to Thursday from 7 AM to 7 PM and Friday from 7 AM to 5 PM. They are closed on Saturday and Sunday. If Luis is busy on a job site when you call, leave a message with your name, your address and a short description of the project.

LCR Home Solutions LLC is at 579 Jewel St, Lochbuie, CO 80603, and serves Lochbuie and the surrounding areas. Call ahead with your address so Luis can confirm the drive and fit your project into the schedule before he comes out to look at it.
